extraFacts.fact: Cam and groove coupling types: Type A is a male adapter x female NPT, Type B a female coupler x male NPT, Type C a female coupler x hose shank, Type D a female coupler x female NPT, Type E a male adapter x hose shank, Type F a male adapter x male NPT, Type DC a dust cap that closes a male adapter, and Type DP a dust plug that closes a female coupler. A female coupler has cam arms and engages a male adapter.
extraFacts.source: Indus Hydraulics guide 'Cam and groove coupling types: A, B, C, D, E, F, DC and DP explained' and the Indus Type A to DP listings; A-A-59326 (formerly MIL-C-27487)

extraFacts.fact: 1 bar = 14.5038 psi, so 250 psi is about 17 bar, 150 psi about 10 bar and 75 psi about 5 bar.

faqs.q: What is the Dixon Boss-Lock Type C aluminium cam coupler used for?
faqs.a: The Dixon Boss-Lock Type C is an aluminium female cam and groove coupler with a hose shank, for connecting a hose to a male adapter. The listing has 9 part numbers from 3/4" to 6", all ending -C-AL, with the maker's rating from 100 to 250 psi by size.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Dixon Boss-Lock Type C aluminium cam coupler come in?
How do I read Dixon Boss-Lock part numbers such as 200-C-AL?
faqs.a: In 200-C-AL, 200 is the 2" size (75 is 3/4", 125 is 1-1/4", 400 is 4"), C is the Type C female coupler with hose shank and AL is aluminium. The size table rows show the same pattern on every part number.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Dixon Boss-Lock Type C aluminium cam coupler?
faqs.a: The maker states 100 to 250 psi depending on size: 250 psi (17 bar) from 3/4" to 2", 150 psi at 2-1/2", 125 psi at 3" and 100 psi at 4"; the 6" row has no figure listed. The rating of an assembly is the lowest rating of any part in it.

faqs.q: What is the Dixon Boss-Lock Type C aluminium cam coupler made of?
faqs.a: The body is aluminium with a hose shank and the Boss-Lock cam arms. The listing gives no gasket compound for this range; ask for it when you order if the medium matters.

faqs.q: Which standard does the Dixon Boss-Lock Type C coupler follow?
faqs.a: The listing gives no standard or certificate for this range, only the type letter and the maker's pressure by size. Quote the Dixon part number, or the mating half, so we confirm that the profiles match before supply.

faqs.q: What does the Dixon Boss-Lock Type C coupler connect to?
faqs.a: It engages a male cam and groove adapter of the same size, such as the [EZ Boss-Lock Type E male adapter](/p/dixon-ez-boss-lock-type-e-male-adapter-hose-shank-aluminium), and takes a hose on its shank. Only halves from the same interchange profile and size seal at their rating; see [cam and groove coupling types](/blog/cam-and-groove-coupling-types).

faqs.q: Dixon Boss-Lock Type C or EZ Boss-Lock Type C coupler: what is the difference?
faqs.a: The Boss-Lock is the standard Dixon cam coupler in aluminium, while the [EZ Boss-Lock Type C](/p/dixon-ez-boss-lock-cam-and-groove-couplers-hose-shank-type-c) is a stainless steel coupler for 2 to 3 inch hose with a notched shank for notched ferrules. Choose aluminium for weight and stainless for corrosion.

faqs.q: How is a Dixon Boss-Lock Type C coupler fitted to a hose?
faqs.a: Slide the hose onto the shank and secure it with a hose band or clamp of the right size. Close the cam arms onto the male adapter and check the gasket is seated; see [hose clamps, sleeves and ferrules](/c/hose-clamps-sleeves-ferrules).

faqs.q: What is the Dixon lockable cam and groove dust cap used for?
faqs.a: Dixon lockable dust caps are cam and groove caps that close a male adapter and can be locked in place. The listing has 3 part numbers in 2", 3" and 4", in aluminium and stainless steel, with a nitrile seal.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Dixon lockable cam and groove dust cap come in?
faqs.a: Three part numbers: 200DC-LSS (2", stainless steel with an investment-cast handle), 300DC-LAL (3", aluminium) and 400DC-LAL (4", aluminium).

faqs.q: How do I read Dixon lockable dust cap part numbers such as 300DC-LAL?
faqs.a: In 300DC-LAL, 300 is the 3" size, DC is the dust cap, L is lockable and AL is aluminium; 200DC-LSS is the 2" lockable cap in stainless steel (SS). The three rows show this pattern.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Dixon lockable cam and groove dust cap?
faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure rating, because a dust cap is not a pressure part; it only protects the male adapter. Use it to close an idle line, not to hold pressure.

faqs.q: What is the Dixon lockable cam and groove dust cap made of?
faqs.a: The caps are aluminium or stainless steel with a nitrile rubber seal. Choose stainless steel for corrosive or marine surroundings and aluminium where weight matters.

faqs.q: What does lockable mean on a Dixon cam and groove dust cap?
faqs.a: The cap is a dust cap that can be locked on, so it stays on the adapter until it is unlocked. That reduces tampering and loss at a tank or storage connection; the listing gives no other approval for the range.

faqs.q: What do Dixon lockable dust caps fit?
faqs.a: They fit a male cam and groove adapter of the same size, 2", 3" or 4", and seal on the nitrile gasket. Standard Type DC caps are [listed separately](/p/dixon-cam-and-groove-type-dc-dust-caps); see [cam and groove coupling types](/blog/cam-and-groove-coupling-types).

faqs.q: Dixon lockable dust cap or standard Type DC dust cap: which should I buy?
faqs.a: The lockable cap can be locked on, in 2" to 4", while the [standard Type DC dust cap](/p/dixon-cam-and-groove-type-dc-dust-caps) is the plain version in more materials and smaller sizes. Choose lockable where tampering or loss is a concern.

faqs.q: How do you fit a lockable cam and groove dust cap?
faqs.a: Place the cap over the male adapter, close the cam arms and fit the lock. Check the nitrile gasket is present before closing; the cap protects the adapter but is not a pressure seal.

faqs.q: What does a Dixon cam and groove test cap fit?
